plum.$description: Brand: dark primary (name/CV). Palette D: darkened from #5A1545.

magenta.$description: Accent secundario — badges, tags, CTA de menor jerarquía (Palette D image role). No component consumer yet.

orange.$description: Accent principal / CTA primario. Palette D's image hex is #E2694A, but that's only 3.31:1 with white text — fails AA. Darkened along the same hue/sat (H12° S72%) to L45%: 5.06:1 with white. The lighter #E2694A has no consumer at a contrast that clears AA, so it wasn't kept as a separate unused primitive.

orangeStrong.$description: CTA hover — same hue/sat as orange, one step darker (L37%). 6.82:1 with white.

cream.$description: Neutral: page background. Palette D: cooler direction, was #FAF9F5.

charcoal.$description: Neutral: primary text. Palette D: cooler near-navy-black, was #1A1416.

amber.$description: Semantic base: warning. Palette D: nudged toward coral, was #B45309. Subtle/on/border not yet recomputed.

green.$description: Semantic base: success. Palette D image: this IS the Tertiary/success color, not a separate role — unified here rather than kept as two roles at two hues. 9.94:1 with white text. Was #158053 (a rotation toward this hue that stopped short); the former separate brand.tertiary/color.tertiary primitive is gone.

teal.$description: Semantic base: info. Palette D: nudged toward the deep-green family, was #0F6E6D. Subtle/on/border not yet recomputed.

crimson.$description: Semantic base: danger. Palette D: nudged toward magenta, was #BE123C. Subtle/on/border not yet recomputed.

tealSubtle.$description: status.infoSubtle fill (light). Not yet recomputed for Palette D.

tealStrong.$description: status.onInfo foreground (light). Not yet recomputed for Palette D.

tealBorder.$description: status.infoBorder (light). Not yet recomputed for Palette D.

greenSubtle.$description: status.successSubtle fill (light). Tuned for the earlier 154.8° rotation, now 14° off the true 169° success base (#1E4A42) — pending recompute, same as info/warning/danger.

greenStrong.$description: status.onSuccess foreground (light). Pending recompute — see greenSubtle.

amberSubtle.$description: status.warningSubtle fill (light). Not yet recomputed for Palette D.

amberStrong.$description: status.onWarning foreground (light). Not yet recomputed for Palette D.

amberBorder.$description: status.warningBorder (light). Not yet recomputed for Palette D.

crimsonSubtle.$description: status.dangerSubtle fill (light). Not yet recomputed for Palette D.

crimsonStrong.$description: status.onDanger foreground (light). Not yet recomputed for Palette D.

crimsonBorder.$description: status.dangerBorder (light). Not yet recomputed for Palette D.

inkMuted.$description: Muted body text — 70% ink. Palette D: re-based on new charcoal #0B2027.

inkCaption.$description: Captions — 63% ink. Palette D's new, slightly darker cream (#F7F2F5) undercut the previous 60% (4.33:1 on bg.page, 4.48:1 on bg.surface — both under the 4.5:1 floor). 63% clears it: 4.76:1 on bg.page, 4.94:1 on bg.surface.

inkLine.$description: Hairline borders — 48% ink. Palette D: re-based on new charcoal #0B2027 (was based on #1A1416).

cream2.$description: Subtle alt background (MyWeb's --color-bg-alt). Unchanged by Palette D.

tealBrand.$description: Inverse surface. Unchanged by Palette D (light theme only).

sageLight.$description: Muted text on the inverse surface. Also reused in dark theme for text.heading under Palette D.
